text:
Ana: quick proposal 1d microexperiment: pair a short launch post + 30min demo webinar with a tiny onboarding bundle (3 prompt templates + $3 test credit). see if this nudges activation more than post-only.
Priya: nice. what's the hypothesis?
Ana: hypothesis: bundled CTA -> higher first-use rate within 48h vs post CTA alone. small cost but measurable signal.
Tom: routing wise, should webinar registrants get a different email path than bundle claimers?
Kemi: yes separate. webinar registrants go into the demo nurture; bundle claimers go into a quick-start drip that surfaces the templates. we can measure cross-conversion.
Ben: bundle contents idea: 1) 'quickstart chat' for product discovery, 2) 'extract & summarize' for showing value, 3) 'semantic search seed' for embeddings quick win.
Ana: credit amount: $3 should be enough to drive 1-2 tries. scalable and low-risk.
Priya: copy variants: Variant A (product-first): "Redwood launch bundle: 3 free templates + $3 to try". Variant B (webinar-first): "Join our 30-min demo + get a hands-on template pack".
Kemi: landing pages: make two small LPs, same hero but different subheads and CTAs. Track UTM and experiment_id.
Tom: ops-bot can you expose a flag and add experiment metadata to the user_create webhook? need fields: experiment_id, bundle_claimed, webinar_registered.
ops-bot: flag created: launch_bundle_1. webhook payload will include: \"experiment\":\"launch_bundle_1\",\"bundle_claimed\":false,\"webinar_registered\":false. enable for cohort new_signups_14d_global.
Ben: measurement plan: primary = % who generate at least one successful response within 48h. secondary = webinar attendance rate, % who claim bundle, and 7d retention.
Priya: export queries: Tom can you wire a short BigQuery view for experiment dimension + attribution?
Tom: yep. i'll add a daily job and share dataset link. ETA 48h.
Ana: timeline: prep assets this week, enable flags Fri morning, run experiment 14 days, then quick readout.
Kemi: I'll build LP drafts by Thu EOD and share variants.
Ben: I'll produce the template text + short usage notes (1-2 lines each).
Priya: FYI we should gate the credit so it's one-per-user and auto-expire after 7 days. ops-bot can we enforce?
ops-bot: credit_limit: 1 per user; credit_expiry_days: 7. implemented.
Ana: cool. also add a tiny in-LP demo gif to show how to paste a prompt and get a response 680
Kemi: good call. will mock that.
Tom: quick config snippet for infra:```json
{"experiment":"launch_bundle_1","cohort":"new_signups_14d_global","credit":3,"templates":["chat_quickstart_v1","extract_summary_v1","embed_seed_v1"],"flags":{"bundle_claimed":false,"webinar_registered":false}}
```
Priya: owners: Ana (experiment owner), Kemi (LP + assets), Ben (templates), Tom (infra + metrics), me (copy + email). I'll schedule daily check-ins next week.
Ben: small ask 1 - include a short eval set of 8 prompts to watch for hallucination spikes caused by templates.
Ana: agreed. Jules from product can help if needed.
ops-bot: calendar event created: launch-bundle kick-off Fri 09:30.
Priya: great. let's keep the test tight and reconvene after week 1 for a signal check. :eyes:
